Story text: stories/arc-surface.md ## 2 · Agents on the board
Never mock a module — give the code a seam
The owner owns the outer loop
Escalate up when blocked or out of scope
The library is the edit surface
Decompose by testability; delegate the glue
When a term is in question, the definition note wins
A measured claim carries the method that produced it
Pair the fence with the affordance
Render and witness a flag-guarded surface
A compliance gate turns a judgment ceremony into theatre
Minimum test to red: pin the missing behaviour, nothing else
A contract that says "observable" must name its observer
Cross-story dependency direction and the no-cycle rule
Claim by write-ownership — the capability you will write
Slow growth: the minimum to green
The reader chooses the thread and the depth
An observable is evidence only for what it observes
The resting view is designed, not fitted
A spec body describes only what it contracts
Durable notes carry intent, not implementation surface
The owner-fork bar: escalate ownership, not uncertainty
Route structural forks to story-author, not the owner
An awaited notification is never a turn-ending state
The author of the work is not its only witness
Machine in the loop is the default; a human is the exception
Decide against a standard, not a budget
A human's words are stored verbatim, or not at all
The authoritative source beats the derived one
Escalate inline, or on a named signal
A decision that blinds an instrument escalates inline
Read the force a decision answered, not the clause it left behind
A deferral recorded without a status reads as pending work
Prose names a set it never checked
A check that could not run is unverified, not refuted
De-noising promotes a signal, never drops it
Tightening a shared contract needs a full sweep
Mechanical waiting never pays context rent
Verify an edit persisted, or escalate
Citing a document is not reading it
Accepted decisions carry no stale prose
Show what matters at the stage they are at
A story's proof proves the goal, not the surface
An escape sequence in a tool argument becomes a real byte
The same file in another tree is a different file
Friction earns durable guidance by supporting evidence, not by being reported
Migrate a library schema: expand, migrate, contract

noShelfMeaning: No recorded route from a shelf; no depth. Pooled at the centre, never unimportant.
